question: Who among the following was the first Indian athlete to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viswanathan Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Viswanathan Anand, an Indian chess grandmaster, became the first recipient of the prestigious **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** in 1991-92.
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award is the highest sports honor in India and is given for outstanding performance in sports.
 
• Viswanathan Anand was recognized for his exceptional achievements in chess, including winning the **FIDE World Chess Championship in 2000**.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest chess players in history and has inspired generations of Indian chess players.
 
• Anand has received numerous other accolades, including the Padma Shri (1986), Padma Bhushan (2001), and Padma Vibhushan (2007).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar**

 
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is one of the greatest cricketers in the history of the sport but **did not win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award first.**
 
• He received the award in 1997-98, making him the first cricketer to win this honor.
 
• Nicknamed the "Little Master," Tendulkar has numerous records, including being the highest run-scorer in Test and ODI cricket.
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu**
 
 
• PV Sindhu is a world-class badminton player who won the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2016.
 
• She made history by becoming the **first Indian woman to win a silver medal at the Olympics** in badminton during the Rio 2016 Games.
 
• Sindhu continues to be an inspiration in Indian sports and has been recognized with several awards, including the Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• **Leander Paes**
 
 
• Leander Paes is a legendary Indian tennis player known for his exceptional doubles performances.
 
• He won the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 1996-97 for his significant achievements, including winning the bronze medal at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics in singles.
 
• Paes holds the record for the most doubles titles won in tennis and has represented India in multiple Olympics.
